title: 19th Annual Day Celebrations
summary: CPE Junior College celebrated its 19th Annual Day with great enthusiasm, bringing together students, parents, faculty, and management to celebrate a year of academic excellence, achievements, and talent.
tagline: Celebrating achievement, excellence, talent, and the spirit of the CPE family.
image_alt: A CPE student welcoming a guest with a bouquet at the 19th Annual Day celebrations
about_image_alt: Students and faculty together on the decorated stage at CPE's Annual Day celebrations
paragraphs: CPE Junior College celebrated its 19th Annual Day with great enthusiasm, bringing together students, parents, faculty, and management to celebrate a year of academic excellence, achievements, and talent.

A special highlight of the occasion was the felicitation of the proud parents of All India CA & CMA Rankers, recognising their invaluable support and encouragement behind these outstanding achievements. Cash awards were presented to CA & CMA Rankers in recognition of their exceptional performance.

Continuing its annual tradition of recognising academic excellence, CPE also presented cash cheques of ₹5,000 each to all first-year students who secured 480+ marks out of 500, acknowledging their dedication and outstanding academic performance.
